scripts.build:wasm: cargo build --manifest-path ../wasm/Cargo.toml --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir wasm/pkg --out-name staticgrind_effects ../wasm/target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/staticgrind_effects.wasm
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.android:debug: npm run android:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.android:aab: npm run android:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat bundleRelease
